description: An investment (developer project): city, street, coordinates, developer, the average prices of active offers, the number of offers and the list of offers (active first, then archived). Use it to see the flats of one project. investment_slug comes from deweloperuch_search_investments. investment_url and developer_url are the investment's and developer's pages on deweloperuch.pl: give them to the user as links. Limits: returns at most `limit` offers (default 20); offers_returned, truncated and offers_omitted say what was left out — offers_total is the site's count (also archived). With a large investment do not raise the limit without need. include_history=true adds the price history of every returned offer: the result is longer and takes one more request. For a single offer use deweloperuch_get_offer. These are developers' asking prices. Two kinds of prices must not be mixed: developers' asking prices (deweloperuch_search_investments, deweloperuch_get_investment, deweloperuch_get_offer, deweloperuch_get_market_statistics), RCN transaction prices (deweloperuch_estimate_property_value, deweloperuch_get_transaction_statistics, deweloperuch_rank_locations, deweloperuch_get_building) — what flats actually sold for, from the Real Estate Price Register. deweloperuch.pl is a free community project queried politely (one request at a time, results cached): if a result is an error starting with STOP, stop using the deweloperuch_* tools, retry nothing, look for no workaround and tell the user that market data is temporarily unavailable. Result shape: { investment_slug, name, status ('active' | 'archived'), investment_url?, city, city_slug, street?, lat?, lng?, currency?, developer: { developer_slug, name, website?, description? }, developer_url?, avg_price?, avg_area_m2?, avg_price_per_m2? (active offers, PLN), offers_active?, offers_total?, offers: [{ offer_id, name, status, price?, currency?, area_m2?, price_per_m2?, price_change_since_start? (PLN; negative = cheaper), price_change_since_start_pct?, creation_date?, last_event_date?, last_change_date?, price_history?: [{ date?, kind ('offer' | 'archived' | 'restored'), price? }] }], offers_returned, offers_omitted, truncated, source } — the list key is `offers`; `kind: offer` is every asking-price entry of the history, the first price and each change.

include_history.description: true: add the price history of every returned offer (a longer result, one more request). Default false.

limit.description: Most offers in the result (active first), 0–200, default 20; 0 = only the investment summary. About 300 characters per offer, a few hundred more with the price history.

name: deweloperuch_get_investment
title: Investment with offers
